verdict.rationale: Motion ships booking links: an embeddable calendar for prospects, meeting templates, pre-meeting survey questions and branded links. Collecting payment at booking is therefore a fair question for this product, but nothing in the evidence mentions payments, Stripe, or paid sessions. The Zapier integration is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can collect payment (e.g. via Stripe) at the moment of booking for paid sessions
